issue: _etw (IProcessMonitor : IDisposable) is Stop()'d but never Dispose()'d; a new EtwProcessMonitor is created per connect cycle via _monitorFactory, leaking its ManualResetEventSlim kernel WaitHandle each time
fix: Replace `try { _etw?.Stop(); } catch { }` with `try { _etw?.Dispose(); } catch { }` — EtwProcessMonitor.Dispose() calls Stop() internally and additionally disposes _sessionReady.

issue: FreeConfigFetcher (:22), FreeConfigGeoIp (:33), FreeConfigPoolFetcher (:59) each create an HttpClient in their ctor; none implement IDisposable, FreeConfigAggregator has no Dispose, and FreeConfigsPageViewModel.Dispose (:153) only unhooks events — 3 socket pools + FreeConfigGeoIp's SemaphoreSlim (:19) leak for the app session
fix: Make the three fetcher classes implement IDisposable (dispose their HttpClient / SemaphoreSlim), have FreeConfigAggregator implement IDisposable and dispose all children, then call _aggregator.Dispose() from FreeConfigsPageViewModel.Dispose().

issue: Local SemaphoreSlim(MaxConcurrency) in TestAllAsync is never disposed after Task.WhenAll completes
fix: Change to `using var sem = new SemaphoreSlim(MaxConcurrency);` so it is disposed when the method exits.
